summary: T3-07 passes. All three listed checks exit 0: test_terrain_parity.py runs 49 tests, make check is clean, and make test runs 1523 tests. Both fixtures carry the required header fields and the PRD 8.8 tolerances, and both are under 1 MB (940,875 and 230,650 bytes). The fixture commit, config sha256 and byte-identity regeneration are enforced by tests I saw pass. I found no changes to config/run.yaml, uv.lock or pyproject.toml. I did not re-run the failing-first step, and I ran only the story's checks and no extra mutation checks.

checks.evidence: The commit order shows 192f98f (tests) before 1644ed8 (implementation). progress.txt records 46 failed, 3 errors at 192f98f. I did not re-run that commit.
ruff check passed, ruff format --check passed (15 files), mypy strict reported no issues in 15 source files.

findings.claim: The terrain fixture is 940,875 bytes against the 1 MB limit, so adding a case or lag would break the size criterion.
findings.evidence: wc -c reports 940875. test_files_are_small enforces the limit.

findings.claim: Byte-identity depends on git history: producing_commit is the last commit touching the three source files. CI needs a full checkout, and any edit to those files requires regenerating and committing the fixtures.
findings.evidence: test_header_carries_provenance compares producing_commit to git log -1 over the source files. The notes flag the fetch-depth requirement.

findings.claim: Two paths outside the story's files list are in the diff. They are orchestration bookkeeping (review state and progress log), not product code.
findings.evidence: git diff --stat lists prd.json and progress.txt.
